hookups.source: https://www.lansetownshippark.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/campground-map-and-site-amenities-2025.pdf ('Site Descriptions - Updated: Jan, 2025': AMPERAGE 50 at sites 1-14, 18, 19, 27-29; 30 at the rest), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Site depths run 14-50 ft (2025 site list): sites 4, 5, 14 and 19 are 50 ft deep, 7-12, 18, 27, 28 and 30 are 34-40 ft; sites 1-3, 15-17 and 20-26 are marked 'Tent/Small RV suggested' (21-23 sloping). Some sites need an extension cord.

sites.source: https://www.lansetownshippark.org/ ('We have 30 tent and RV sites, some with views of Lake Superior') + https://www.lansetownshippark.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/campground-map-and-site-amenities-2025.pdf (site dimensions and notes), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.lansetownshippark.org/ ('Amenities & Services: Free WiFi, Dump Station, RV and Tent Sites, Lake Superior Beach, Shower Building'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Camping season mid May - mid October; the park's trails are open year-round.

Book online through the township's Beds24 page ('Book Now' on lansetownshippark.org/reservations) or by phone. Must be 18 to reserve. 'Holiday weekend minimum is 3 nights' (Memorial Day, the 4th of July, Labor Day). One day's rate is withheld on every cancellation; no refunds within 7 days.

booking.source: https://www.lansetownshippark.org/reservations/ ('Book Now' -> beds24.com propid 130990) + https://www.lansetownshippark.org/ ('Holiday weekend minimum is 3 nights. Holiday weekends include Memorial Day, the 4th of July, and Labor Day.'), read 2026-10-22

note: L'Anse Township park 2 mi north of L'Anse (15829 Skanee Road), on a sloping hillside above Keweenaw Bay (Lake Superior), the site of the first trading post and original townsite of L'Anse. Pavilion, playground, Lake Superior beach, dock and gazebo. ~$35/night RV. --Claude
summary: Township site confirms 30 tent/RV sites (2025 site list: 50-amp at 18 sites, 30-amp at the rest; several 'Tent/Small RV suggested'; deepest 50 ft), showers, dump, WiFi, season mid May - mid October, online booking on Beds24 with a 3-night holiday-weekend minimum; phone (906) 524-6985 matches. No rate is posted on the site and Beds24 showed no prices for out-of-season dates, so fees stay empty. Note trimmed of site/hookup/facility/booking/season text.
